products.name: PRINCE® D1 GOLD 4X4 SAE 5W-40 CK-4/SN
facts: P-12 Ester-Based Fully Synthetic Engine Oil
description: Expertly-engineered to address the extreme thermomechanical stresses of modern turbocharged, high-pressure common-rail direct-injection (CRDI) Euro IV, V, VI diesel engines, PRINCE® D1 GOLD 4X4 SAE 5W-40 CK-4/SN combines severely hydroisomerized, high-purity synthetic base stocks with proprietary Group V P-12 Ester-Based Technology, leveraging inherent molecular polarity to enhance surface affinity and boundary lubrication. Its high HTHS viscosity, low-volatility properties and exceptional shear stability maintain robust hydrodynamic film integrity under severe mechanical loads and elevated operating temperatures. A cutting-edge low-SAPS additive system delivers superior resistance to thermal-oxidative degradation, soot-induced abrasive wear, pitting, cylinder bore polishing and piston deposit build-up, while minimizing lubricant-derived ash accumulation in exhaust aftertreatment systems. Enhanced detergent-dispersant chemistry and optimal Total Base Number (TBN) retention effectively suppress soot agglomeration, neutralize acid combustion by-products and control viscosity thickening, ensuring sustained lubrication action and engine durability under demanding operating conditions including prolonged drain intervals.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Ideal for on-road and off-road diesel applications requiring API CK-4 specified diesel engine oils, as well as gasoline engines requiring API SN standard. Developed particularly for turbocharged, intercooled, high-speed diesel engines meeting Euro IV, V and VI emission standards, featuring high-pressure common-rail direct injection (CRDI) technology. Suitable for pickup trucks, light-duty utility vehicles, SUVs, heavy-duty commercial fleets, tractors and off-highway machinery, including engines incorporating highly-advanced variable geometry turbochargers (VGT), as well as multi-stage turbocharging and multi-stage fuel injection technologies. Compatible with sensitive emission control systems and aftertreatment devices, including diesel particulate filter (DPF), diesel oxidation catalysts (DOC), selective catalytic reduction (SCR) and exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) systems.

description: PRINCE® ATF 3H is a premium-quality transmission fluid formulated with carefully chosen base stocks and advanced additive technology to deliver reliable lubrication and protection for a wide range of conventional automatic transmission systems in passenger vehicles, vans, trucks, buses, tractors, mining and construction machinery. Its carefully balanced frictional characteristics promote smooth gear engagement and consistent hydraulic operation, while effective anti-wear additives help safeguard transmission gears, bearings, and clutch components against premature wear and scoring. Optimized shear and thermal-oxidative stability, combined with reliable foam suppression, helps maintain fluid performance and consistent transmission operation under varying driving conditions and temperatures.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Formulated for passenger cars, SUVs, commercial trucks, and selected commercial transmission systems requiring DEXRON III-H or compatible earlier-generation ATF specifications. Primarily intended for conventional 3-speed and 4-speed automatic transmissions, as well as applicable power steering and hydraulic systems where the specified fluid requirements are met.

products.name: PRINCE® ATF HD PRO FLEET
description: PRINCE® ATF HD PRO FLEET is an advanced fully synthetic heavy-duty automatic transmission fluid developed to address the stringent performance requirements of modern commercial vehicle transmissions operating under prolonged oil drain intervals. Its cutting-edge friction modifier technology promotes consistent clutch engagement and smooth power transmission, while superior thermal and oxidation stability minimizes fluid degradation under sustained heavy loads. Enhanced shear stability, anti-wear protection, corrosion and foam control ensure dependable hydraulic performance and prolonged transmission service life.

products.name: PRINCE® ATF HD
description: PRINCE® ATF HD is a heavy-duty automatic transmission fluid formulated with carefully chosen hydrocracked base stocks and a balanced additive system to deliver reliable lubrication and hydraulic performance in conventional commercial vehicle transmissions. Its optimized frictional characteristics ensure consistent clutch engagement and smooth gear transitions, while effective anti-wear, oxidation resistance, corrosion and foam control safeguard transmission components throughout recommended service intervals.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 80W-90
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 80W-90 is a high-performance mineral blend gear oil formulated with premium-quality base oils and extreme-pressure (EP) additive chemistry to provide dependable protection against gear wear, scuffing and pitting. Its balanced formulation promotes smooth synchronizer operation, thermal stability and effective protection against rust, corrosion and foaming under demanding operating conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for synchronized and non-synchronized manual transmissions, transaxles and moderately loaded gear assemblies in passenger cars, commercial vehicles, agricultural tractors and construction equipment requiring SAE 80W-90 API GL-4 specified gear oil.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 85W-90
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 85W-90 is a mineral blend gear oil formulated with carefully chosen base stocks and robust extreme-pressure (EP) additive chemistry to protect transmission gears and bearings against abrasive wear, scoring and surface fatigue. Its stable lubricating film provides reliable load-carrying capability, complemented by effective oxidation resistance, corrosion protection and foam control.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Suitable for conventional manual transmissions, auxiliary drives, transfer cases and moderately loaded gear assemblies in trucks, tractors, and other heavy-duty equipment requiring SAE 85W-90 API GL-4 specified gear oil.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 90
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4 SAE 90 is a multi-use monograde gear oil developed with hydrocracked base stocks to provide shear-stable, reliable lubrication and load-bearing protection in conventional transmission and drivetrain assemblies. Its effective extreme-pressure (EP) and anti-wear chemistry maintains lubricating film integrity under sustained loads, while protecting metallic components against corrosion, oxidation, micropitting and premature wear.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Suitable for a broad spectrum of older-generation manual transmissions, auxiliary gearboxes, final drives and moderately loaded differentials in commercial vehicles, tractors, construction machinery and industrial equipment requiring SAE 90 API GL-4 specified gear oil.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4/GL-5 SAE 75W-90
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-4/GL-5 SAE 75W-90 is a specially formulated fully synthetic, high-performance gear oil fortified with advanced extreme-pressure (EP) additives and carefully balanced frictional technology to satisfy both API GL-4 and API GL-5 lubrication requirements. Its optimized additive chemistry combines synchronizer-compatible protection for specified manual transmissions with the high load-carrying capacity required by heavily-loaded hypoid gears, differentials and axles. Exceptional resistance to scuffing, wear, micropitting, thermal oxidation, and mechanical shearing helps preserve transmission integrity and lubricant stability under severe operating conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for passenger cars, SUVs, light commercial vehicles, and heavy-duty trucks equipped with hypoid differentials, drive axles, transfer cases, final drives, and synchronized or unsynchronized manual transmissions. Suitable for heavily-loaded gear assemblies requiring SAE 75W-90 API GL-5 fluid specification and compatible manual gearboxes specifying API GL-4, or MT-1 performance, subject to manufacturer requirements.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 75W-90
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 75W-90 is a universal, fully synthetic, high-performance hypoid gear oil formulated with advanced extreme-pressure (EP) additive technology for heavily loaded axle and differential assemblies. Its excellent high load-carrying capacity and uncompromising lubricating film provide exceptional protection against gear tooth scuffing, micropitting, and adhesive wear under severe contact pressures and shock loading. Outstanding thermal and oxidation stability, combined with excellent shear resistance and anti-foaming capacity, helps preserve lubricant integrity and drivetrain component lasting durability under sustained high-temperature operation.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for passenger cars, SUVs, light commercial vehicles, heavy-duty trucks, and off-highway equipment equipped with hypoid differentials, drive axles, final drives, and other heavily loaded gear assemblies requiring SAE 75W-90 API GL-5 fluid specification.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 80W-90
description: Built to withstand relentless mechanical stress, PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 80W-90 is a premium extreme-pressure hypoid gear lubricant formulated with carefully selected, highly refined hydrocracked (HC) base stocks and an advanced extreme-pressure (EP) additive system. Its robust lubricating film provides dependable protection against gear tooth scuffing, pitting, and wear under high contact pressures and shock loading. Excellent thermal and oxidation stability, combined with effective corrosion protection and resistance to foaming, helps maintain lubricant integrity and reliable drivetrain performance throughout demanding operating conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Formulated for passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, heavy-duty trucks, buses, tractors, and construction equipment equipped with hypoid differentials, drive axles, final drives, and heavily loaded bevel or spiral-bevel gear assemblies requiring SAE 80W-90 API GL-5 gear fluid.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 +LSD SAE 85W-90
description: Designed for superior traction control and unparalleled differential and hypoid drive axle protection, PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 +LSD SAE 85W-90 is a premium limited-slip hypoid gear oil developed to deliver smooth, progressive clutch engagement and exceptional durability under demanding operating conditions. Its carefully optimized frictional characteristics effectively minimize differential chatter, shudder, and stick-slip behaviour, ensuring refined operation in clutch-type limited-slip differentials. A robust lubricating film provides outstanding resistance to gear tooth scuffing, pitting, and component wear under tough loads and shock loading, while excellent thermal stability and oxidation resistance help preserve consistent lubrication performance and gear system durability. Particularly suited to a broad range of Toyota and other compatible vehicle applications requiring SAE 85W-90 LSD gear oil.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, heavy-duty trucks, tractors, and off-highway equipment equipped with clutch-type limited-slip differentials, multi-plate self-locking differentials, hypoid drive axles, and final drives requiring SAE 85W-90 API GL-5 fluid specification with limited-slip characteristics. Suitable for selected Toyota pickup trucks and 4WD vehicles, as well as compatible conventional open differentials, where the manufacturer specifies, or permits this gear oil type.

sections.label: Industry Standards, Specifications, & Recommendations
items: Toyota Limited Slip Differential Gear Oil SAE 85W-90

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 85W-90
description: Built for enduring strength under demanding drivetrain conditions, PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 85W-90 is a premium extreme-pressure hypoid gear oil formulated with selected, highly refined hydrocracked (HC) base stocks to deliver maximized protection in heavily-loaded axle and differential gear systems. Its robust lubricating film withstands intense gear tooth contact pressures and shock loading, providing optimal resistance to scuffing, micropitting, and premature wear. Optimized thermal and oxidation stability, combined with effective corrosion protection and resistance to foaming, helps preserve lubricant integrity and consistent drivetrain performance under sustained high-temperature and severe-duty operating conditions.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, heavy-duty trucks, buses and construction equipment equipped with hypoid differentials, drive axles, final drives, and heavily loaded bevel or spiral-bevel gear assemblies requiring SAE 85W-90 API GL-5 gear oil.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 85W-140
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 85W-140 is a heavy-duty mineral gear oil formulated with high-quality base stocks and robust extreme-pressure (EP) additive chemistry to protect heavily loaded hypoid gears against scuffing, scoring and surface fatigue. Its high-viscosity formulation maintains strong lubricating film integrity under severe mechanical loads and elevated operating temperatures, complemented by effective oxidation resistance, corrosion protection and foam control.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Designed for heavily loaded hypoid differentials, drive axles and final drives in commercial trucks, buses, agricultural machinery, construction equipment and off-highway vehicles requiring SAE 85W-140 API GL-5 gear oil.

products.name: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 140
description: PRINCE® SUPER-SHIFT GL-5 SAE 140 is a heavy-duty monograde mineral gear oil formulated with high-viscosity base stocks and advanced extreme-pressure additive chemistry to deliver reliable load-carrying protection under severe operating conditions. Its robust lubricating film safeguards hypoid gears and bearings against adhesive wear, scoring and shock loading, while effective oxidation and corrosion inhibitors promote prolonged component service life.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Particularly suited for conventional hypoid differentials, heavy-duty drive axles and final drives in older-generation, hardworking commercial vehicles, agricultural machinery, mining and construction equipment requiring SAE 140 gear oil of this specification.

products.name: PRINCE® POWER STEERING FLUID
description: PRINCE® POWER STEERING FLUID is a multi-vehicle, high-performance hydraulic fluid formulated with highly refined base stocks and a specialized additive system to deliver smooth, responsive power steering operation and dependable hydraulic pressure transmission. Fortified with outstanding anti-wear, anti-foam and friction-control additives, it helps minimise steering pump squeal, whining and chatter while reducing friction, wear and noise. Its excellent oxidation stability, deposit-control properties and corrosion protection help prevent sludge and varnish buildup, reduce the risk of hydraulic passage clogging, and protect pumps, valves and steering gear components for long-lasting performance and reliability.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for conventional hydraulic power steering systems requiring GM DEXRON II, GM DEXRON III or Ford MERCON-type automatic transmission fluids, including compatible passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, vans and commercial vehicles from a broad range of American, European, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean manufacturers. Well suited for hydraulic steering pumps, rack-and-pinion steering assemblies, recirculating ball steering gears and associated hydraulic circuits where ATF-type power steering fluids are specified. However, it is not recommended for Honda/Acura systems requiring dedicated Honda Power Steering Fluid without ATF standards, as well as CHF 11S and CHF 202-type central hydraulic systems or other applications requiring highly-specialized hydraulic lubricants.

products.name: PRINCE® POWER STEERING FLUID WITH STOP LEAK
description: PRINCE® POWER STEERING FLUID WITH STOP LEAK is a high-performance hydraulic fluid formulated with the combination of highly refined base stocks, specially chosen anti-wear additives and specialized seal-conditioning agents to help restore ageing elastomeric seals and minimize minor fluid leakage caused by seal shrinkage and hardening. Its improved friction-control, antioxidants and anti-foam chemistry helps reduce steering pump squeal, whining, chatter and vibration while maintaining smooth hydraulic pressure transmission and responsive steering performance.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Ideally suitable for conventional hydraulic power steering systems requiring GM DEXRON II, GM DEXRON III or Ford MERCON-type automatic transmission fluids, particularly in older and high-mileage vehicles experiencing minor fluid seepage caused by ageing, hardened or shrunken seals. Suitable for compatible passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, vans and commercial vehicles, helping reduce minor seal related leakage, steering pump noise and rough steering operation.

products.name: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 5.1
facts: FMVSS 116 DOT 5.1, ISO 4925 Class 5-1, SAE J1704
description: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 5.1 is a state-of-the-art, high-performance brake fluid formulated with glycol ethers and borate esters and exceptional additive technology to offer superior thermal stability, oxidation resistance, precise hydraulic pressure transmission and reliable braking performance under demanding operating conditions. Its optimized low-temperature viscosity characteristics ensure rapid hydraulic response and accurate pressure modulation in advanced anti-lock braking systems (ABS), electronic stability control (ESC/ESP) and traction control systems. Featuring a Dry Equilibrium Reflux Boiling Point (ERBP) exceeding 260°C and a Wet ERBP exceeding 175°C, it provides excellent resistance to vapour lock, while advanced corrosion inhibitors protect critical hydraulic components and compatible elastomeric seals against corrosion and fluid degradation.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Specifically designed for high-performance and modern hydraulic disc and drum braking systems, including Anti-lock Braking Systems (ABS), Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Electronic Stability Control (ESC/ESP), Traction Control Systems (TCS/ASR) and compatible hydraulic clutch actuation systems of the latest generation. Suitable for passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, light and heavy commercial vehicles requiring DOT 5.1 or compatible glycol-based DOT 4 brake fluids, subject to manufacturer recommendations. However, this fluid is not suitable for systems requiring silicone-based DOT 5 or mineral-based hydraulic fluids.

products.name: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 4
facts: FMVSS 116 DOT 4, ISO 4925 Class 4, SAE J1704
description: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 4 is a high-performance brake fluid formulated with glycol ethers and borate esters to deliver excellent thermal stability, consistent hydraulic pressure transmission and reliable braking performance under demanding operating conditions. Its enhanced viscosity characteristics support responsive brake actuation and effective hydraulic pressure modulation in modern braking systems and compatible Anti-lock Braking Systems (ABS), while advanced corrosion inhibitors protect master cylinders, callipers, hydraulic valves and elastomeric seals. Featuring a Dry Equilibrium Reflux Boiling Point (ERBP) exceeding 240°C and a Wet ERBP exceeding 160°C, it helps minimise vapour lock and retain uncompromising braking efficiency during repeated braking cycles.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Designed for conventional hydraulic disc and drum braking systems, including compatible Anti-lock Braking Systems (ABS), Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD) and compatible hydraulic clutch actuation systems. Suitable for passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, vans and light and heavy commercial vehicles, and motorcycles requiring DOT 4 or compatible glycol-based DOT 3 brake fluids. However, this fluid is not suitable for systems requiring silicone-based DOT 5 or mineral-based hydraulic fluids.

products.name: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 3
facts: FMVSS 116 DOT 3, ISO 4925 Class 3, SAE J1703
description: PRINCE® BRAKE & CLUTCH FLUID DOT 3 is a premium-quality glycol ether based brake fluid formulated to deliver reliable braking performance, smooth hydraulic pressure transmission and consistent clutch operation. Its balanced viscosity characteristics and anti-corrosion and anti-residue additives help protect critical hydraulic components, minimize fluid degradation and maintain dependable system performance. The excellent foam depression agents shield against foam formation and air entrainment to support stable hydraulic pressure transmission and consistent brake pedal response.

sections.label: Intended Applications
sections.text: Developed for conventional hydraulic disc and drum braking systems and hydraulic clutch actuation systems across generations. Suitable for use in passenger cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, vans, light and heavy commercial vehicles where DOT 3 brake fluid is specified by the manufacturer.

products.name: PRINCE® 50/50 ANTIFREEZE/COOLANT HD ELC −37°C
facts: ASTM D3306, ASTM D4985, ASTM D6210, ASTM D7583
description: PRINCE® 50/50 ANTIFREEZE/COOLANT HD ELC −37°C is a premium extended-life heavy-duty antifreeze coolant formulated with high-purity monoethylene glycol, demineralized water and advanced nitrite-free organic acid inhibitor technology. Its long-lasting carboxylate-based corrosion inhibitor system is designed to provide exceptional protection against wet cylinder liner cavitation, pitting corrosion, aluminium erosion and electrochemical degradation, while minimizing mineral scale and deposit formation to maintain optimum heat transfer efficiency. The ready-to-use 50/50 formulation provides freeze protection down to −37°C, with a targeted extended service life of up to 6 years, 1,000,000 km or 12,000 operating hours, whichever occurs first, under properly maintained cooling system conditions.

products.name: PRINCE® 50/50 ANTIFREEZE/COOLANT HD ELC NOAT −37°C
facts: ASTM D3306, ASTM D4985, ASTM D6210, ASTM D7583
description: PRINCE® 50/50 ANTIFREEZE/COOLANT HD ELC NOAT −37°C is a cutting-edge, high-performance extended-life heavy-duty coolant combining advanced organic acid technology and fortified with nitrite-molybdate corrosion inhibitors to deliver reinforced protection under the most severe diesel engine operating conditions. Its specialized dual-inhibitor system provides enhanced resistance against cavitation-induced cylinder liner erosion, pitting, localized corrosion and coolant degradation under sustained thermal and mechanical stress. Premixed with demineralized water at a 50/50 concentration, it provides freeze protection down to −37°C, with a targeted extended service life of up to 6 years, 1,000,000 km or 12,000 operating hours, whichever occurs first, under properly maintained cooling system conditions.

products.name: PRINCE® 50/50 ANTIFREEZE/COOLANT HD −37°C
facts: ASTM D3306, ASTM D4985, ASTM D6210, ASTM D7583
description: PRINCE® 50/50 ANTIFREEZE/COOLANT HD −37°C is a fully formulated heavy-duty engine coolant incorporating a stabilized low-silicate corrosion inhibitor system pre-charged with supplemental coolant additives (SCAs) to provide instant protection against wet cylinder liner cavitation, pitting corrosion and electrochemical deterioration. Its balanced inorganic inhibitor chemistry safeguards ferrous and non-ferrous cooling system components against rust, scale formation and corrosive degradation, while maintaining efficient heat transfer under demanding operating conditions. The ready-to-use formulation provides freeze protection down to −37°C, with a targeted service life of up to 3 years or 400,000 km, whichever occurs first, subject to periodic monitoring and maintenance of SCA concentration.
